content: Root cause: The bug was caused by a backward compatibility issue that was introduced in a previous change (OOZIE-2748), specifically related to how empty arguments were handled in Java actions within Oozie workflows. The system inadvertently changed the behavior of passing empty arguments, where previously, they were allowed as "null" values in the args[] array. The absence of a configuration setting to control this behavior led to discrepancies when executing workflows that relied on certain payload structures, resulting in actions failing unexpectedly. The patch added mechanisms to restore the previous behavior by introducing a configuration option to manage empty arguments.
